

## Pulling data


```{r}
file.exists("assignments/assignment06-eda-ai-audit/BCCDC_COVID19_Dashboard_Case_Details.csv")
getwd()
```


```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(knitr)


gp_candidate_paths <- c(
 "assignments/assignment06-eda-ai-audit/BCCDC_COVID19_Dashboard_Case_Details.csv"
)


gp_data_path <- gp_candidate_paths[file.exists(gp_candidate_paths)][1]
if (is.na(gp_data_path)) {
 stop("Could not find BCCDC_COVID19_Dashboard_Case_Details.csv")
}


gp_dataset <- read_csv(gp_data_path, show_col_types = FALSE)
```


```{r}
summary(gp_dataset)
```




## Clear analytic sample or cohort definition


```{r}
analysis_gp <- gp_dataset |>
 filter(Sex != "U") %>%
 filter(Classification_Reported != "Epi-linked") %>%
 filter(Age_Group != "Unknown")


cohort_counts <- tibble(
 step = c("Prepared CSV rows", "Rows after Sex restriction"),
 n = c(nrow(gp_dataset), nrow(analysis_gp))
)


kable(cohort_counts)
```




## Short explanation of inclusion and exclusion decisions
Decision to restrict sex to be male or female and exclude cases in which there is
an unknown gender due to sex analysis being a key variable in the analysis. Decision 
to restrict age group to be not unknown due to age analysis being a key variable in the analysis. Excluded cases that are classified as "Epi-linked" so that our data can
analyze confirmed cases of COVID-19 and not just probable cases. 


## Missingness check for key variables
```{r}
key_vars <- c("HA", "Sex", "Age_Group", "Classification_Reported", "Reported_Date")


missingness <- tibble(variable = key_vars) |>
 mutate(
   missing_n = vapply(analysis_gp[key_vars], function(x) sum(is.na(x)), numeric(1)),
   missing_percent = round(100 * missing_n / nrow(analysis_gp), 1)
 )


kable(missingness)
```


## Table 1-style descriptive summary
```{r}
table1summary <- c("HA", "Sex", "Age_Group", "Classification_Reported") |>
 purrr::map_dfr(function(variable) {
   analysis_gp |>
     mutate(
       Level = if_else(
         is.na(.data[[variable]]),
         "Missing",
         as.character(.data[[variable]])
       )
     ) |>
     count(Level, name = "n") |>
     mutate(
       Characteristic = variable,
       Percent = round(100 * n / sum(n), 1)
     )
 }) |>
 mutate(
   Characteristic = recode(
     Characteristic,
     HA = "Health Authority",
     Sex = "Sex",
     Age_Group = "Age group",
     Classification_Reported = "Case classification"
   )
 ) |>
 select(Characteristic, Level, n, Percent)


knitr::kable(
 table1summary,
 col.names = c("Characteristic", "Category", "Cases (n)", "Percent (%)"),
 caption = "Table 1. Characteristics of the analytic sample"
)
```

## At least one figure or table generated by code


```{r}


table1 <- analysis_gp |>
 filter(!is.na(HA)) |>
 count(HA, name = "COVID_cases", sort = TRUE)


kable(table1, col.names = c("Health Authority", "COVID cases"))


table2 <- analysis_gp |>
 filter(!is.na(Sex)) |>
 count(Sex, name = "COVID_cases", sort = TRUE)


 kable(table2, col.names = c("Sex", "COVID cases"))


table3 <- analysis_gp |>
 filter(!is.na(Age_Group)) |>
 count(Age_Group, name = "COVID_cases", sort = TRUE)


kable(table3, col.names = c("Age Group", "COVID cases"))


table4 <- analysis_gp |>
 mutate(Year = as.integer(format(as.Date(Reported_Date), "%Y"))) |>
 filter(Year %in% 2020:2023) |>
 group_by(Year) |>
 summarise(COVID_cases = n(), .groups = "drop") |>
 tidyr::complete(
   Year = 2020:2023,
   fill = list(COVID_cases = 0)
 ) |>
 arrange(Year)


kable(table4, col.names = c("Year", "COVID cases"))



```




## A methods note that states what the summary can and cannot claim
We used the BC COVID-19 Dashboard Case Details CSV snapshot. The analysis cohort included
records with sexes Male and Female, Lab-diagnosed cases, and age groups 10-19, 20-29, 30-39,
40-49, 50-59, 60-69, 70-79, 80-89, and 90+. We summarized each health authority, sex, and age
group by case count using unweighted descriptive statistics. Missing values were checked before
summarizing. These summaries describe the BC COVID-19 cases and should not be interpreted as
causal effects or population estimates.
























































## Code for AI use
```{r}
library(tidyverse)  # AI-EDIT(2026-06-23): tidyverse-default — consolidated core library() calls into library(tidyverse)
library(knitr)


candidate_paths <- c(
  "examples/nhanes-equity/data/nhanes_equity_v6.csv",
  "../../examples/nhanes-equity/data/nhanes_equity_v6.csv"
)


data_path <- candidate_paths[file.exists(candidate_paths)][1]
if (is.na(data_path)) {
  stop("Could not find examples/nhanes-equity/data/nhanes_equity_v6.csv")
}


nhanes <- read_csv(data_path, show_col_types = FALSE)


analysis_df <- nhanes |>
  filter(Age >= 20, Age <= 80)


cohort_counts <- tibble(
  step = c("Prepared CSV rows", "Rows after age 20-80 restriction"),
  n = c(nrow(nhanes), nrow(analysis_df))
)


kable(cohort_counts)
```
